title: Remove goal UI and display monthly totals only

requirements.summary: Remove all goal-related labels/values from habit rows and show only the monthly total value.
acceptanceCriteria: In the habit row UI, there is no text "Goal" rendered anywhere (including "Goal: 0").
For non-reps/time habits, the monthly total section shows only "Monthly total: <value>" with no "/" and no secondary value.
For reps/time habits, the monthly total section continues to show only the monthly total (as it does today).

file_operations.description: Remove the goal-related line from the habit info cell for non-reps/time unit types (do not render any "Goal" label/value). Keep per-completion display only for reps/time if desired, but ensure it never uses goal copy. Update the monthly total area to always render only the monthly total value (remove the "/" separator and any "/ Goal: …" segment). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (shadcn-ui Checkbox/Popover are composed here).

requirements.summary: Remove goal-related UI from the habit edit modal; only show/save per-completion volume for reps/time habits.
acceptanceCriteria: When editing a habit with unit type not equal to "reps" or "time", the modal does not display the volume/goal input at all.
When editing a habit with unit type "reps" or "time", the modal continues to show the "Volume per completion" input and saves as before.
No UI text "Monthly Goal" appears anywhere in the app.

file_operations.description: Remove the "Monthly Goal" label/copy and conditionally render the volume input block only when unit type is "reps" or "time". Adjust save logic so volume updates are only attempted for "reps"/"time" (no goal storage/editing path for other units). Keep time validation/parsing behavior intact for "time". Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (shadcn-ui Dialog/Select/Input/Button/Label are composed here).

requirements.summary: Ensure no goal-related copy/UI remnants exist anywhere in the habit UI while keeping monthly totals visible.
acceptanceCriteria: A global pass through the habit tracking UI confirms no goal-related strings are rendered anywhere.
Monthly totals still render correctly for all unit types across month tabs.

file_operations.description: Audit and remove any remaining goal-related strings/branches (e.g., "Goal:") and ensure the monthly totals remain visible and unchanged in placement across unit types after REQ-1 changes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (shadcn-ui Checkbox/Popover are composed here).

Audit and remove any remaining goal-related copy (e.g., "Monthly Goal") and ensure the modal still supports reps/time volume-per-completion editing without exposing goal UI for other unit types. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (shadcn-ui Dialog/Select/Input/Button/Label are composed here).
